newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BOE SHAREHOLDERS APPROVE NBS, BOLAND LINK.
newsitem.headline: BOE SHAREHOLDERS APPROVE NBS, BOLAND LINK.

text.p: Board of Executors Ltd shareholders on Tuesday unanimously approved a complex deal which will see it join forces with NBS Holdings Ltd and Boland Bank Holdings Ltd to create South Africa's fifth largst banking group.

BOE announced on March 13 that it had decided to buy 22.2 percent of NBS shares at 68.35 cents each or a total of 1.37 billion rand while NBS Boland would buy 24.3 percent of BOE for 880 million rand.
After the merger of NBS and Boland next month, BOE's shareholding will fall to 17.2 percent of the enlarged group.
BOE's acquisition has been financed through the private placement of shares with major institutions, which was heavily oversubscribed and had to be scaled back.

The other major shareholder in NBS Boland will be Samgro Investment Holdings Ltd , the pyramid company of Boland Bank headed by Christo Wiese, which will own 15 percent after the merger with rights to take up another 19 percent to take its shreholding up to 34.9 percent.
